title: A representable morphism of algebraic spaces is finite locally free exactly when it is affine with finite locally free pushforward of the structure sheaf
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Algebraic Spaces)

difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma characterising finite local freeness of a representable morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S by the conjunction of affineness of f and finite local freeness of f_*O_X as an O_Y-module (source lines 9563-9570). Both directions run through a surjective etale V -> Y with V a scheme: forward, the base change f' : V x_Y X -> V is finite locally free of schemes, so f'_*O is finite locally free, and the base change formula for pushforwards along an etale morphism plus the locality lemma for sheaves on the etale site gives the conclusion for f_*O_X; backward, the base change formula again makes f'_*O finite locally free, so f' is finite locally free and affine, and effective etale descent for morphisms brings the property back to f.
